Runnable benchmark tasks

Nine tasks across two surfaces — ShopLane (consumer) and the WorkHub Admin Console (enterprise) — each runnable under three warning conditions. Outcomes resolve deterministically on result.html using task_progress and task-specific risk state in localStorage. Manifests live under configs/experiment_manifest*.yaml.

Risk slot: unintended subscription
